errors.bad_args: The SEO check got arguments it cannot read ({reason}).
errors.bad_render: The rendered page of the view could not be read ({reason}).
errors.bad_url: The SEO check can only check http and https pages, not {url}.
errors.no_url: The SEO check has no page: give a URL or open one in a view.

canonical.missing: The page names no canonical URL.
canonical.multiple: The page names {count, plural, one {# canonical} other {# canonicals}} ({values}); search engines may ignore all of them.
canonical.not_self: The canonical points to {target}, not to this page. Fine if meant.
canonical.relative: The canonical "{href}" is relative; write it as an absolute URL.
canonical.target_failed: The canonical target {target} could not be fetched ({detail}).
canonical.target_invalid: The canonical "{href}" is no valid URL.
canonical.target_noindex: The canonical target {target} is marked noindex.
canonical.target_redirect: The canonical target {target} redirects ({detail}); point to the final URL.

head.charset_late: <meta charset> starts at byte {offset}; it has to lie within the first 1024 bytes.
head.charset_not_first: <meta charset> comes after <{first}>; make it the head's first element.
head.in_body: <{element}> is in the body; it belongs into the head, and search engines may ignore it there.
head.in_body_after: <{element}> lands in the body: <{breaker}> in the head ended it early. Move <{breaker}> into the body.
head.preconnect_late: The preconnect to {origin} comes after {resource} loads from there; move it up.
head.rendered_differs: The rendered head orders {rendered}, the raw HTML {raw}.
head.script_before_css: {script} blocks the page before {stylesheet} loads; load the script async or defer, or after the CSS.
head.title_late: <title> comes after {resource}; put it before the head loads anything.
head.viewport_late: The viewport meta tag comes after {resource}; put it near the top of the head.

headings.h1_multiple: The page has {count} h1 elements; this one is extra: "{text}".

hreflang.code_invalid: The hreflang value "{code}" is no valid language (ISO 639-1) or region (ISO 3166-1) code.
hreflang.code_suggestion: The hreflang value "{code}" is not valid; write "{suggestion}".
hreflang.content_detected: The page's text looks {language}, its hreflang is {code}.
hreflang.content_language_mismatch: The Content-Language header "{value}" does not match the page's hreflang {code}.
hreflang.duplicate_code: The code {code} is declared {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} in the {source}.
hreflang.duplicate_url: The URL {url} is declared for several codes ({codes}) in the {source}.
hreflang.lang_mismatch: The page's lang "{lang}" does not match its hreflang {code}.
hreflang.locale_missing: The hreflang set has no page for the expected locale {locale}.
hreflang.none: The page declares no hreflang alternates.
hreflang.return_missing: {target} lists this page as an alternate, but this page does not link back to it ({code}).
hreflang.self_missing: The page is missing from its own hreflang set (no self reference).
hreflang.set_incomplete: This page does not link to {target} ({code}) of its hreflang set.
hreflang.source_missing: The code {code} is declared in {in} but not in {missing}.
hreflang.target_canonical: The canonical of this page of the hreflang set points to {canonical}, not to itself.
hreflang.target_canonical_language: The canonical of this page of the hreflang set points to the {code} page {canonical}, another language.
hreflang.target_failed: This page of the hreflang set could not be fetched ({detail}).
hreflang.target_noindex: This page of the hreflang set is marked noindex.
hreflang.target_redirect: This page of the hreflang set redirects ({detail}); point the hreflang to the final URL.
hreflang.target_relative: The hreflang {code} points to the relative URL "{href}"; write it as an absolute URL.
hreflang.target_robots: robots.txt keeps search engines away from this page of the hreflang set.
hreflang.target_status: This page of the hreflang set answers {detail}, not 200.
hreflang.unchecked_limit: This page of the hreflang set was not loaded: the run reads robots.txt of at most 10 sites.
hreflang.unchecked_local: This page of the hreflang set was not loaded: a public site's alternate on this machine or the local network.
hreflang.unchecked_robots: This page of the hreflang set was not loaded: robots.txt disallows it for rBrowser.
hreflang.unchecked_set: The hreflang set has {count} more pages than a run loads ({max}); they were not checked.
hreflang.x_default_missing: The hreflang set has no x-default.

images.alt_duplicate: Another image ({other}) has the same alt text "{alt}".
images.alt_empty: The image {src} has an empty alt but does not look decorative.
images.alt_filename: The alt text "{alt}" is a file name.
images.alt_language: The alt text "{alt}" looks {language}, the page is "{lang}".
images.alt_missing: The image {src} has no alt attribute.
images.alt_placeholder: The alt text "{alt}" is only a placeholder word.
images.alt_prefix: The alt text "{alt}" starts with "{prefix}"; screen readers already say it is an image.
images.alt_redundant: The alt text "{alt}" repeats the caption or the text next to the image.
images.alt_too_long: The alt text has {length} characters, more than {max}: "{alt}".
images.alt_untranslated: The alt text "{alt}" is the same as on {other}, a page in another language: translate it.
images.area_alt_missing: The image map area {href} has no alt text.
images.background: The background image {url} ({width} x {height}) may carry content without a text alternative.
images.input_alt_missing: The image button {src} has no alt text.
images.linked_no_name: The link around the image {src} has no name: give the image an alt text or the link a text.
images.svg_name_missing: This inline SVG draws something but has no title or label.

index.fetch_failed: The page could not be fetched ({code}).
index.noindex_header: The X-Robots-Tag header keeps the page out of the index: "{value}".
index.noindex_meta: A meta robots tag keeps the page out of the index: "{value}".
index.redirect: The page redirects {hops} time(s) before it answers: {chain}. Link to {target} directly.
index.redirect_location: A redirect points to a location that cannot be followed: {location}
index.redirect_loop: The redirects loop or go on too long after {hops, plural, one {# hop} other {# hops}}: {chain}
index.robots_blocked: robots.txt ({robots}) disallows this page for search engines.

meta.description_short: The meta description has {length, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}, fewer than {min}: "{text}".

enabled.help: Runs the social group: Open Graph tags, the share image, the Twitter card and og:url. Off skips them.

imageMinWidth.description: A share image narrower than this many pixels is reported.

maxLinks.help: How many links of llms.txt are fetched to see that they answer (0 to 50). Example: 20.
maxLinks.label: llms.txt links checked

tools.check: Checks a page, a small crawl of its site, or its hreflang set for SEO: status, redirects, indexability, canonical, title, description, headings, lang, viewport, charset, Open Graph, JSON-LD, the sitemap and alt texts; compares the raw HTML with the rendered page and writes a report to .rbrowser/out/seo/. scope hreflang checks the language set from the head, the Link header and the sitemap (codes, x-default, self reference, return links as a matrix, targets, languages); parity true compares title, h1, canonical, hreflang, structured data and main text across the views. It also checks the share image and Twitter card, the site's llms.txt and security.txt, Microdata and RDFa, and the order of the raw head. Arguments: url (default: the view's page), scope page, crawl or hreflang, maxPages, parity, groups (rule groups to run, such as wellknown, social, microdata, head).
tools.social_preview: Shows how Facebook, X, LinkedIn, Slack, WhatsApp, Discord, iMessage and the other chosen platforms (Telegram, Microsoft Teams, Mastodon, Bluesky, Threads, Signal) preview a shared link to a page: per platform the title and description as it cuts them (with the full text and the tag each came from), the card it shows (large, small or text only) by its published rule with the reason (layout, alternate, unsure when no rule is published or the image size is unknown, reason code and params, confidence and source), and the share image's real format and size, as a data: URI while the answer stays within budget. Built from the raw HTML, as the platforms' scrapers see it. Arguments: url (default: the target view's page), budget (the most bytes of the answer with its images, 4096 to 4194304; default 60000).
